title: Russell Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith accuses him of violence and abuse against her
description: Goldsmith accuses the disgraced entertainer of "violence, coercive control and abuse" while the two were together.

title: What happened inside court as Brand was sentenced
description: The BBC's Sima Kotecha was inside the court as the judge sentenced Brand to 10 years and six months in prison, after being convicted of rape and sexual assault.

title: Hundreds more offenders to leave jail on Tuesday
description: At least 1,350 offenders have been released from jail early under the scheme so far.

title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
description: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

title: Trump says Iran war is 'effectively over' militarily with further strikes unlikely
description: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation in the Middle East change.

title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
description: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

title: 'Baffling but brilliant' post-apocalyptic novel The End of Everything wins Booker Prize
description: M John Harrison becomes the oldest ever winner of the prestigious literary award at the age of 81.

title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
description: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.

title: FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy, Trump says
description: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.
